_meta.definition: The process of managing and coordinating various aspects of the enterprise's core business operations, including human resources, production, purchasing, and sales.

HumanResources Department._description: Tracks department information within the Human Resources division of Adventure Works.

columns.name: DepartmentID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in HumanResources Department

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores department names within HumanResources, such as Engineering, Sales, Marketing, etc. (up to 50 characters)

columns.name: GroupName
columns.description: Stores department names for organizational units, such as Research and Development, Sales and Marketing, Inventory Management.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when a record was last modified.

HumanResources Shift._description: Tracks scheduled work shifts for employees in the Human Resources department.

columns.name: ShiftID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in HumanResources Shift

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores shift names, such as Day, Evening, or Night.

columns.name: StartTime
columns.description: Stores shift start times in a 24-hour format (e.g., 07:00:00) as date-time strings with a specific year (1899).

columns.name: EndTime
columns.description: Stores the specific end time (in 24-hour format) for each shift.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores date and time of last modification for each shift record.

Person AddressType._description: Maps address types (e.g., Home, Work) associated with individuals in the Adventure Works database.

columns.name: AddressTypeID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Person AddressType

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores address type designations such as Billing, Home, Main Office, Primary, Shipping.

columns.name: rowguid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the rowgu entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when the corresponding address type was last modified.

Person ContactType._description: Maps contact types for individuals in the Adventure Works database.

columns.name: ContactTypeID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Person ContactType

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores job titles of contacts associated with individuals in the Person ContactType table.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when a contact type was last modified.

Person CountryRegion._description: Tracks geographical regions associated with employees and vendors in the Adventure Works database.

columns.name: CountryRegionCode
columns.description: Stores two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries/regions.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores the names of countries or regions for employees in the Person CountryRegion table.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when the Person CountryRegion record was last modified.

Person PersonPhone._description: Tracks contact phone numbers for individual employees and vendors in Adventure Works.

columns.name: BusinessEntityID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Business Entity entity

columns.name: PhoneNumber
columns.description: Stores formatted U.S. phone numbers (11 digits including area code) for individuals associated with Person PersonPhone table.

columns.name: PhoneNumberTypeID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Phone Number Type entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores date and time of modification for each phone record associated with a person.

Person PhoneNumberType._description: Maps unique phone number types associated with individuals in the Adventure Works database.

columns.name: PhoneNumberTypeID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Person PhoneNumberType

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores a designation for the type of phone number (Cell, Home, Work) associated with a person.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: The ModifiedDate column stores timestamps of when phone number types were last modified.

Person StateProvince._description: Captures information about various state provinces for different countries in the Adventure Works context.

columns.name: StateProvinceID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Person StateProvince

columns.name: StateProvinceCode
columns.description: Stores two-digit codes for U.S. states or provinces.

columns.name: CountryRegionCode
columns.description: Stores two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries of residence within U.S. states for individuals.

columns.name: IsOnlyStateProvinceFlag
columns.description: Indicates whether a state province is the sole location for an employee within the company.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores names of French departments (administrative regions).

columns.name: TerritoryID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Territory entity

columns.name: rowguid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the rowgu entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when the Person StateProvince record was last modified.

Production Culture._description: Tracks various cultural aspects within the Production department at Adventure Works.

columns.name: CultureID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production Culture

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores language names for production culture settings.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when the production culture was last modified.

Production Location._description: Tracks manufacturing locations, their associated costs, inventory availability, and modification history for efficient production management.

columns.name: LocationID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production Location

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores descriptive names of locations within the Production facility.

columns.name: CostRate
columns.description: Stores per-unit production cost rates for each item.

columns.name: Availability
columns.description: Stocks available at each production location.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when the production location was last modified.

Production Product._description: Tracks detailed information about manufactured goods and their specifications in the production process.

columns.name: ProductID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production Product

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores descriptive names for various production items such as Adjustable Race, Bearing Ball, Crown Race, Decal 1, and Decal 2.

columns.name: ProductNumber
columns.description: Stores unique product identifiers, formatted as alphanumeric codes, up to 10 characters long.

columns.name: MakeFlag
columns.description: The Production Product MakeFlag column indicates whether a product is domestically manufactured (False) in the database.

columns.name: FinishedGoodsFlag
columns.description: The Production Product's FinishedGoodsFlag column indicates whether a product is unfinished (False) in the AdventureWorks database.

columns.name: Color
columns.description: Stores product color options, typically black or silver.

columns.name: SafetyStockLevel
columns.description: Holds the predefined quantity of a product that should be maintained as an inventory reserve.

columns.name: ReorderPoint
columns.description: Holds the minimum inventory level for each product before reordering is initiated.

columns.name: StandardCost
columns.description: Stores the base cost of each production product unit.

columns.name: ListPrice
columns.description: Stores approximate unit prices for individual production products.

columns.name: Size
columns.description: Stores clothing size options for products (M, L, S).

columns.name: SizeUnitMeasureCode
columns.description: Stores standard unit codes for product dimensions (e.g., CM) in the Production Product table.

columns.name: WeightUnitMeasureCode
columns.description: Stores standard weight unit codes (e.g., G for gram) for production products.

columns.name: Weight
columns.description: Stores approximate product weights in grams or kilograms.

columns.name: DaysToManufacture
columns.description: Stores the number of days required to manufacture a product unit.

columns.name: ProductLine
columns.description: Stores a short character string representing product lines (S for bicycles, M for motorized) in the Production Product table.

columns.name: Class
columns.description: Stores product size classification (L, M) in the Production Product table.

columns.name: Style
columns.description: Stores product style identifiers, each limited to a maximum of 10 characters (e.g., 'U').

columns.name: ProductSubcategoryID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Product Subcategory entity

columns.name: ProductModelID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Product Model entity

columns.name: SellStartDate
columns.description: Stores the initial sales date for each product.

columns.name: SellEndDate
columns.description: Stores the planned end date for selling a specific product.

columns.name: DiscontinuedDate
columns.description: Stores the date when a product was discontinued (text format, no samples provided).

columns.name: rowguid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the rowgu entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamp of the last modification for each production product.

Production ProductCategory._description: Captures product categories and their attributes in the Adventure Works manufacturing database.

columns.name: ProductCategoryID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production ProductCategory

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores descriptive names for product categories such as Bikes, Components, Clothing, and Accessories.

columns.name: rowguid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the rowgu entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamps for the last modification of product categories.

Production ProductModel._description: Captures detailed information about unique product models in the production department of Adventure Works.

columns.name: ProductModelID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production ProductModel

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores descriptive names of various clothing items such as Classic Vest, Cycling Cap, etc., for the Production ProductModel table.

columns.name: CatalogDescription
columns.description: Stores XML formatted product descriptions linked to an external style sheet.

<root xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ProductModelManuInstructions">
                Adventure Works CyclesFR-210B Instructions for Manufacturing HL Touring Frame. Summary: This document contains manufacturing instructions for manufacturing the HL Touring Frame, Product Model 7. Instructions are work center specific and are identified by Work Center ID. These instructions must be followed in the order presented. Deviation from the instructions is not permitted unless an authorized Change Order detailing the deviation is provided by the Engineering Manager.<Location LaborHours="2.5" LotSize="100" MachineHours="3" SetupHours="0.5" LocationID="10">
                    Work Center 10 - Frame Forming. The following instructions pertain to Work Center 10. (Setup hours = .5, Labor Hours = 2.5, Machine Hours = 3, Lot Sizing = 100)<step>
                        Insert <material>aluminum sheet MS-2341</material> into the <tool>T-85A framing tool</tool>.
                    </step><step>
                        Attach <tool>Trim Jig TJ-26</tool> to the upper and lower right corners of the aluminum sheet.
                    </step><step>
                        Using a <tool>router with a carbide tip 15</tool>, route the aluminum sheet following the jig carefully.
                    </step><step>
                        Insert the frame into <tool>Forming Tool FT-15</tool> and press Start.
                    </step><step>
                        When finished, inspect the forms for defects per Inspection Specification <specs>INFS-111</specs>.
                    </step><step>Remove the frames from the tool and place them in the Completed or Rejected bin as appropriate.</step></Location><Location LaborHours="1.75" LotSize="1" MachineHours="2" SetupHours="0.15" LocationID="20">
                    Work Center 20 - Frame Welding. The following instructions pertain to Work Center 20. (Setup hours = .15, Labor Hours = 1.75, Machine Hours = 2, Lot Sizing = 1)<step>
                        Assemble all frame components following blueprint <blueprint>1299</blueprint>.
                    </step><step>
                        Weld all frame components together as shown in illustration <diag>3</diag></step><step>
                        Inspect all weld joints per Adventure Works Cycles Inspection Specification <specs>INFS-208</specs>.
                    </step></Location><Location LaborHours="1" LotSize="1" LocationID="30">
                    Work Center 30 - Debur and Polish. The following instructions pertain to Work Center 30. (Setup hours = 0, Labor Hours = 1, Machine Hours = 0, Lot Sizing = 1)<step>
                        Using the <tool>standard debur tool</tool>, remove all excess material from weld areas.
                    </step><step>
                        Using <material>Acme Polish Cream</material>, polish all weld areas.
                    </step></Location><Location LaborHours="0.5" LotSize="20" MachineHours="0.65" LocationID="45">
                    Work Center 45 - Specialized Paint. The following instructions pertain to Work Center 45. (Setup hours = 0, Labor Hours = .5, Machine Hours = .65, Lot Sizing = 20)<step>
                        Attach <material>a maximum of 20 frames</material> to <tool>paint harness</tool> ensuring frames are not touching.
                    </step><step>
                        Mix <material>primer PA-529S</material>. Test spray pattern on sample area and correct flow and pattern as required per engineering spec <specs>AWC-501</specs>.
                    </step><step>Apply thin coat of primer to all surfaces.  </step><step>After 30 minutes, touch test for dryness. If dry to touch, lightly sand all surfaces. Remove all surface debris with compressed air. </step><step>
                        Mix <material>paint</material> per manufacturer instructions.
                    </step><step>
                        Test spray pattern on sample area and correct flow and pattern as required per engineering spec <specs>AWC-509</specs>.
                    </step><step>Apply thin coat of paint to all surfaces. </step><step>After 60 minutes, touch test for dryness. If dry to touch, reapply second coat. </step><step>
                        Allow paint to cure for 24 hours and inspect per <specs>AWC-5015</specs>.
                    </step></Location><Location LaborHours="3" LotSize="1" SetupHours="0.25" LocationID="50">
                    Work Center 50 - SubAssembly. The following instructions pertain to Work Center 50. (Setup hours = .25, Labor Hours = 3, Machine Hours = 0, Lot Sizing = 1)<step>Add Seat Assembly. </step><step>Add Brake assembly.   </step><step>Add Wheel Assembly. </step><step>Inspect Front Derailleur. </step><step>Inspect Rear Derailleur. </step></Location><Location LaborHours="4" LotSize="1" LocationID="60">
                    Work Center 60 - Final Assembly. The following instructions pertain to Work Center 60. (Setup hours = 0, Labor Hours = 4, Machine Hours = 0, Lot Sizing = 1)<step>
                        Perform final inspection per engineering specification <specs>AWC-915</specs>.
                    </step><step>Complete all required certification forms.</step><step>Move to shipping.</step></Location></root>

<root xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ProductModelManuInstructions">

Instructions are work center specific and are identified by work center ID. These instructions must be followed in the order presented.                     </step><step>

Deviation from the instructions is not permitted unless an authorized Change Order detailing the deviation is provided by the Engineering Manager.<Location LaborHours="1" LotSize="100" MachineHours="2" SetupHours="0.1" LocationID="10">
                    Work Center 10 - Frame Forming. The following instructions pertain to Work Center 10. (Setup hours = .10, Labor Hours = 1, Machine Hours = 2, Lot Sizing = 100)<step>
                        Insert <material>aluminum sheet MS-2259</material> into tool <tool>T-50 Tube Forming tool</tool>.
                    </step><step>
                        Attach <tool>Trim Jig TJ-8</tool> to the upper and lower right corners of the aluminum sheet.
                    </step><step>Route the aluminum sheet following the jig carefully. </step><step>
                        Insert the cut pieces into <tool>Tube Forming Tool FT-90</tool> and press Start.
                    </step><step>
                        When finished, inspect the form for defects per Inspection Specification <specs>INFS-90</specs>.
                    </step><step>Remove the lengths of tube from the tool and place it in the Completed or Rejected bin as appropriate.</step></Location><Location LaborHours="1" LotSize="1" MachineHours="1.75" SetupHours="0.25" LocationID="20">

columns.name: rowguid

Production ProductSubcategory._description: Captures product subcategories and their relationships to products and categories within the production department.

columns.name: ProductSubcategoryID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production ProductSubcategory

columns.name: ProductCategoryID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Product Category entity

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores descriptive names of subcategories within the production category, such as Mountain Bikes, Road Bikes, Touring Bikes, Handlebars, and Bottom Brackets.

columns.name: rowguid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the rowgu entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when the product subcategory was last modified.

Production ScrapReason._description: Tracks reasons for production scrap events in the manufacturing process.

columns.name: ScrapReasonID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Production ScrapReason

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores descriptive reasons for manufacturing defects in production scrap items.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamps for when scrap reasons were last modified (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format).

Production UnitMeasure._description: Tracks unique measurement units and their names used in production processes.

columns.name: UnitMeasureCode
columns.description: Stores standard codes for various packaging units (BOX, BTL, C, CAN, CAR).

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores descriptive names for various units of measure used in production processes.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a series of static date strings for each row in the Production UnitMeasure table.

Purchasing ShipMethod._description: Tracks various shipping methods used for order delivery in the Adventure Works database.

columns.name: ShipMethodID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Purchasing ShipMethod

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores transportation method names, such as truck ground, express, deluxe, overnight, cargo transport.

columns.name: ShipBase
columns.description: Stores estimated base shipping costs for various methods.

columns.name: ShipRate
columns.description: Stores per-unit shipping rates for various purchase methods.

columns.name: rowguid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the rowgu entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when the shipping method was last modified.

Sales CountryRegionCurrency._description: Tracks the currency used for sales transactions in specific geographical regions.

columns.name: CountryRegionCode
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries in sales transactions.

columns.name: CurrencyCode
columns.description: Stores three-letter ISO currency codes for countries in the Sales table.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamp of when a record in Sales CountryRegionCurrency was last modified.

Sales Currency._description: Tracks various currencies used in sales transactions within Adventure Works.

columns.name: CurrencyCode
columns.description: Stores three-letter ISO currency codes for various global currencies.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores the names of currencies used for sales transactions.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a string representation of the date when the sales currency was last modified.

Sales SalesReason._description: Tracks reasons for sales transactions in the Adventure Works database.

columns.name: SalesReasonID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Sales SalesReason

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores descriptive labels for reasons behind sales transactions (e.g., Price, On Promotion, Magazine Advertisement).

columns.name: ReasonType
columns.description: Stores brief descriptions of sales reasons such as Other, Promotion, Marketing.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamps for when sales reasons were last modified (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format).

Sales SalesTaxRate._description: Tracks sales tax rates for different states and tax types in the organization.

columns.description: Foreign key linking to the State Province entity

columns.name: TaxType

columns.name: TaxRate
columns.description: Stores floating-point values representing sales tax rates (e.g., 14%, 14.25%, etc.).

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores combinations of Canadian GST and various provincial taxes.

columns.name: rowguid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the rowgu entity

columns.name: ModifiedDate

Sales SalesTerritory._description: Tracks sales performance and costs across territories in different countries.

columns.name: Name

columns.name: CountryRegionCode

columns.name: Group
